title: Trainer dataset build: append-only Bybit market_raw pull instead of a full 5-year re-pull every night
note: From FREE-CAPACITY-PLAN (a). MEASURED (trainer-vm-diag #23591, runtime_logs/trainer/dataset_builds.jsonl, 5 build runs 11-04..11-06): 9,503 s build wall total; market_features 5,317 s (56%), market_raw 3,375 s (36%; ~675 s per run), forecasts 676 s. ml/datasets/adapters/bybit_offvm.py has no cache: build_trainer_datasets.sh rebuilds ~14 Bybit (symbol, tf) shards from start=5y-ago with --overwrite nightly. BUILD (stays on the trainer: Bybit geoblocks GitHub runners, Kaggle kernels have no internet): fetch only from the existing shard's last ts minus an overlap, merge, rewrite; keep --overwrite semantics for the output. Must prove byte/row identity against a full pull on one shard before shipping (Tier 2, data-mutation job). Also consider whether market_features (5m BTC 1,478 s / ETH 902 / SOL 889) can be incremental. Basis: n=5 build runs (11-04..11-06); 56% and 36% = shares of 9,503 s total build wall.
